messages:
elaine: Heads up — need quick GA sign-off for Predictor-v2. Main gaps: SLA wording (latency p99 vs p95), docs walkthrough, oncall/responder list, monitoring alerts + runbooks, pricing tiers for Dedicated vs Hosted. Who can own each by EOD tomorrow? :eyes:

kevin: I can take SLA wording + latency SLOs. Quick note: p99 for 1 token gen is noisy; recommend p95 200ms, p99 600ms for small models. I'll draft.

nina: Support rota: I can map current oncall to new route but need list of escalation emails. Also want a playbook stub for billing disputes.

sam: Monitoring: I'll add runbooks + pager thresholds. Proposed alerts:
```
- predictor_high_99_latency > 600ms for 5m -> P2
- predictor_errors_rate > 0.5% over 10m -> P1
- prefix_cache_miss_rate > 20% -> P3
```
I'll push dashboard and test queries.

maria: Pricing: need mapping for burst vs reserved; we should publish 3 buckets (dev, standard, dedicated). I'll put numbers in spreadsheet and flag edgecases.

dav: Docs: I'll own the walkthrough and SDK examples. Also need a short 'upgrade' note for existing customers (breaking changes in quantization default).

ops-bot: deploybot: New canary scheduled for 2026-05-15 04:00 UTC. Noted.

kevin: Draft SLA uploaded to /docs/drafts/predictor-v2-sla.md — PTAL @elaine @maria

elaine: @kevin thanks. Nina, can you drop escalation list by EOD? also want one-sentence summary for legal.

nina: Yes. Sending current rotas now. Will annotate who can handle invoice disputes vs infra incidents.

sam: I put initial dashboards in grafana/predictor-v2 -> dashboard id 4321. Need a smoke query from QA to validate.

dav: QA: can we get a 1-hour burnin on dedicated pool? @kevin does runtime autoscale support that yet?

kevin: yes autoscale supports short-burst policy, just need config. I'll add sample:
```
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 2
  max_replicas: 20
  burst_window: 3600 # seconds
```

maria: I've started the pricing sheet: link https://tiny.redwood/pricing-predictor-v2 (internal). Putting example customer size rows.

elaine: Action summary:
- Kevin: SLA + autoscale sample (owner)
- Nina: Oncall + escalation list + billing playbook
- Sam: Dashboards + alert runbooks
- Dav: Docs + SDK examples + upgrade note
- Maria: Pricing tiers + commercial note
Due: EOD tomorrow. If any blocker mark it urgent here.

nina: small blocker: billing playbook needs legal template for refund caps — looping in @elaine for legal ask.

elaine: noted. I'll raise with legal and echo back.

kevin: One more thing — we should include fallback policy in SLA: routed to lighter model if capacity constrained. I'll add language.

dav: Also adding a short "what to say customers" blurb for support to reuse.

sam: I'll run the canary smoke tomorrow and post results. If latencies spike > p95 we'll abort.

maria: commercial review scheduled 2026-05-14 16:00 UTC — inviting product and sales.

ops-bot: reminder: link to rollout checklist: https://tiny.redwood/rollout-checklist

elaine: thanks everyone. I'll compile a single doc for the shiproom tomorrow morning. :rocket:
